steps.sub: How often does chance match it?

code:
import numpy as np
rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
old = rng.normal(52, 15, 40).round(2)
new = rng.normal(58, 15, 40).round(2)
obs = new.mean() - old.mean()
print(round(obs, 2))   # 5.62
caption: Illustrative order values: 40 per email.

code:
pooled = np.concatenate([old, new])
diffs = np.empty(10000)
for i in range(10000):
    rng.shuffle(pooled)
    diffs[i] = (pooled[40:].mean()
                - pooled[:40].mean())
p = (np.abs(diffs) >= abs(obs)).mean()
print(p)   # 0.0343
caption: About 3.4% of shuffles gave a gap this big.
